user.title: Connect to MyRide K-12
user.description: Paste the refresh token captured from your browser session (see the README's capture-tokens.js step). The district tenant ID is detected automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: MyRide K-12 token expired
reauth_confirm.description: Your refresh token has expired (this happens roughly every 30 days). Re-run capture-tokens.js in your browser and paste the new refresh token below.

error.invalid_auth: That token was rejected. Make sure you copied the refresh token (not the access or ID token) - see the README.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach MyRide K-12. Check your network connection and try again.
error.no_tenant: The token validated but didn't include a district/tenant ID - please open an issue.
error.unknown: Unexpected error - please open an issue with the log output.

abort.already_configured: This MyRide K-12 account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: That token belongs to a different MyRide account than this entry. Remove and re-add the integration if you meant to switch accounts.
